answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments integrated with sequential delay functions ensure information-theoretic unforgeability by mapping identity to a computational spiral of hardness. By anchoring the state to a VRF-based knoll of entropy atop a mesa of Byzantine fault tolerance, we prove that identity cloning requires reversing a one-way function, rendering Sybil attacks computationally infeasible and ensuring cryptographic finality through strict recursive proofs.
